biggest_catch: The bonus requires at least $10,000 deposited and held continuously for 90 days — and the current STACK promo window closes September 30, 2026, so if you miss it or dip below your tier, you drop to a lower tier or get nothing.
catches: Minimum $10,000 deposit to qualify for ANY bonus tier; deposits under $10,000 still earn the APY but get $0 bonus.
The qualifying balance must be maintained continuously at or above your tier minimum for the full 90-day maintenance period — if it dips, you are placed in the tier of the lowest balance maintained.
Promo code STACK must be entered at sign-up between September 1 and September 30, 2026; Raisin cannot apply it retroactively, and the offer ends 9/30/2026.

Only funds deposited within 14 days of the initial deposit count toward your tier; the savings+CD boost requires at least $1,000 in a second product category within 14 days, maintained in both categories through day 90.
APYs are variable and can change (the NexBank 4.15% rate is guaranteed only for 90 days for new users, then drops to the standard rate, currently 3.97%); interest is not a fixed payout.
The bonus and interest are both taxable and reported on a 1099-INT.

Raisin is not a bank — it is a marketplace; deposits sit at partner banks, and you are responsible for monitoring FDIC coverage per bank across all your holdings there. Deposits/withdrawals only via ACH to one linked external account.

steps: Go to raisin.com and register a new account, entering promo code STACK at sign-up (do this between September 1 and September 30, 2026 — it cannot be added retroactively).
Link your external bank account (one linked account; ACH only) and make your first deposit.
For the extra savings+CD boost ($10-$100 by tier, up to $1,000 total), put at least $1,000 into a second product category (e.g., a CD) within the same 14-day window.
Keep your qualifying balance continuously at or above your tier minimum for the full 90 days — any dip drops you to a lower tier.
Earn the platform APY meanwhile (top rates ~4.15-4.17%, variable); expect the bonus after the 90-day maintenance period completes.
Report the bonus and interest as taxable income (1099-INT).
timing: First deposit Sept 1-30, 2026 with code STACK; 14-day funding window to reach your tier; balance held continuously 90 days; bonus credited after the maintenance period. Top APY ~4.15% guaranteed 90 days for new users, then variable (~3.97%).
